PaperX.NumberFieldFrobeniusRestriction.exists_simultaneous_frobenius : ∀ (L : Type u_1) [inst : Field L]
  [inst_1 : NumberField L] [inst_2 : Normal ℚ L] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  ∃ Q,
    Q.IsMaximal ∧
      Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {↑p}) ∧
        (PaperX.NumberFieldPrimeRestriction.restrictedPrime L Q).IsMaximal ∧
          (PaperX.NumberFieldPrimeRestriction.restrictedPrime L Q).LiesOver (Ideal.span {↑p}) ∧
            ∃ γ ∈ MulAction.stabilizer PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.GQ Q,
              (∀ (x : ↥PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.IntegralClosure),
                  (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q) (γ • x) = (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q) x ^ p) ∧
                (PaperX.AbsoluteGaloisRestriction.restriction L) γ ∈
                    MulAction.stabilizer Gal(L/ℚ) (PaperX.NumberFieldPrimeRestriction.restrictedPrime L Q) ∧
                  ∀ (x : NumberField.RingOfIntegers L),
                    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PaperX.NumberFieldPrimeRestriction.restrictedPrime L Q))
                        ((PaperX.AbsoluteGaloisRestriction.restriction L) γ • x) =
                      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (PaperX.NumberFieldPrimeRestriction.restrictedPrime L Q)) x ^ p
PaperX.NumberFieldWitnessIndependence.restricted_witnesses_conjugate : ∀ (L : Type u_1) [inst : Field L]
  [inst_1 : NumberField L] [inst_2 : Normal ℚ L] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (u v : PaperX.AbsoluteFrobeniusWitnesses.Witness p),
  p ∉ PaperX.UnramifiedFrobeniusUniqueness.discriminantPrimes L →
    ∃ a,
      a * (PaperX.AbsoluteGaloisRestriction.restriction L) u.element * a⁻¹ =
        (PaperX.AbsoluteGaloisRestriction.restriction L) v.element
PaperX.UnramifiedFrobeniusUniqueness.inertia_card_eq_ramificationIdx : ∀ (L : Type u_1) [inst : Field L]
  [inst_1 : NumberField L] [Normal ℚ L] (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (P : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L))
  [P.IsMaximal] [P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {↑p})], Nat.card ↥(Ideal.inertia Gal(L/ℚ) P) = P.ramificationIdx ℤ
PaperX.UnramifiedFrobeniusUniqueness.finite_ramified_primes : ∀ (L : Type u_1) [inst : Field L] [NumberField L],
  {q | Nat.Prime q ∧ ∃ Q, Q.IsMaximal ∧ Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {↑q}) ∧ Q.ramificationIdx ℤ ≠ 1}.Finite
PaperX.RestrictionEmbeddingConjugacy.restriction_intertwines : ∀
  (L : IntermediateField ℚ PaperX.RestrictionEmbeddingConjugacy.Qbar) [inst : Normal ℚ ↥L]
  (σ : PaperX.RestrictionEmbeddingConjugacy.GQ),
  PaperX.RestrictionEmbeddingConjugacy.embeddingAutomorphism L * (PaperX.AbsoluteGaloisRestriction.restriction ↥L) σ =
    (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom ↥L) σ * PaperX.RestrictionEmbeddingConjugacy.embeddingAutomorphism L
@PaperX.GeneralArithmeticCoverage.finiteFieldCoverage_iff_cofiniteQuotientCoverage : ∀ {X : Type u_1}
  (s : X → PaperX.AbsoluteIntegralFrobenius.GQ),
  PaperX.GeneralArithmeticCoverage.FiniteFieldCoverage s ↔ PaperX.CofiniteConjugacyCoverage.CofiniteQuotientCoverage s
PaperX.GeneralArithmeticCoverage.existentialArithmeticCoverage_iff_arithmeticCoverage : ∀
  (w : (p : PaperX.AbsoluteFrobeniusWitnesses.RationalPrime) → PaperX.AbsoluteFrobeniusWitnesses.Witness ↑p),
  PaperX.GeneralArithmeticCoverage.ExistentialArithmeticCoverage ↔ PaperX.GeneralArithmeticCoverage.ArithmeticCoverage w
